description: Image-grounded long-screwdriver tabletop insertion smoke using a public visible ring socket target: public RGB-D scene evidence, VLM socket-center plus insertion scene.direction, task-conditioned P3SAM/VLM long-screwdriver tip refs, whole-tool SE(3) fixed-goal rollout, and screwdriver-specific tip insertion path success.

target.physical_role: movable public thin guide socket on the tabletop: 3.6 cm visual base, 1.2 cm outer guide diameter, 0.8 cm inner guide diameter, 5.5 cm guide height, open top and center aperture, with thin four-wall collision around the 0.8 cm insertion hole

scene_initialization.start_pose_policy: runtime mesh-table-contact projection keeps the fixed near-hand long_screwdriver mesh on the tabletop with 3 mm clearance; xy and yaw do not vary by seed.

seed_variation_policy.description: Each seed deterministically spreads the visible ring socket over a table-safe grid while the long_screwdriver start pose remains fixed near the robot hand and is shared by the VLM render, compile scaffold, and rollout. Socket yaw is fixed because the ring is rotationally symmetric.

scene_initialization.target_grounding_policy: The shared VLM scene-ref interface applies: natural task language and public top-down RGB-D evidence provide start_point at the visible socket opening and scene.direction for insertion. The runner uses that public direction plus the benchmark inside-socket goal contract for the executable terminal point.
scene_initialization.tool_grounding_policy: Use task-conditioned P3SAM/VLM long_screwdriver refs: VLM selects the screwdriver tip/shaft contact-point part, then selects the contact point marker and shaft/tip motion-axis marker from public evidence for that selected part.
scene_initialization.trajectory_policy: Reset/start-pose scaffold for SimToolReal initialization only; not a method input, target trajectory, oracle trajectory, or success template.

acceptance.success_policy: screwdriver_insert_tip_path: a seed succeeds when the diagnostic path gate, compiled terminal socket goal, rollout semantic insertion path, measured tip XY radial alignment, and measured tip inside-socket depth pass. Tracking/policy-goal pass and full terminal endpoint error are diagnostic.

tool_grounding_contract.notes: Evaluator-side audit labels only; not used for method selection, compiler constraints, or task success. Tip radial alignment and inside-socket depth are the required success metrics.

first_smoke: VLM overlay marks the public deep socket opening center
lifted refs record VLM scene.direction and a task-contract inside-socket terminal goal
constraint program aligns the VLM-selected long-screwdriver tip/shaft axis to the insertion axis
fixed goals compile without hidden evaluator target refs or legacy screwdriver spin task logic
rollout video and rollout_summary are written when rollout is enabled
visual_evidence contains a manifest only and does not duplicate rollout videos
